ff-health-profile-data-quality.note: Matured the existing Health Profile sync diagnostics as the Feature Factory data-quality capability: export payload inspection stays local, reports recognized, empty and unknown metric names, exposes corrective actions, uses an uncontrolled large-payload textarea and caps rendered diagnostic rows at 60 to avoid mobile hangs. No biomedical threshold, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, API contract, dependency or patient-specific inference was added.

academicReview.note: This batch verifies software missingness/name-mapping diagnostics and bounded rendering only; it introduces no biomedical interpretation or clinical decision rule.

ff-health-profile-export.note: Matured the existing Health Profile JSON and history CSV exports: both are explicit user actions over the actual stored profile/history, history export fails closed when no records exist, and no hidden synthesis or network transformation is introduced.

academicReview.note: Portable serialization of user-entered or measured records only; no medical factual, diagnostic, treatment, causal, normative or patient-specific claim is added.

ff-health-profile-fallback.note: Matured the existing Health Profile graceful fallback: explicit loading state, localStorage recovery, local-first save before optional server sync, clear local-only/offline messaging, and fail-safe empty/unrecognized import states are deterministically guarded without weakening any validator.

academicReview.note: Software fallback and state-disclosure behavior only; no biomedical interpretation or clinical claim is introduced.

ff-health-profile-import.note: Matured the existing validated Health Profile import: structured exports use the repo-local parser, preserve source and measuredAt provenance into the shared vitals store, reject unrecognized payloads, cap browser file size at 60 MB, and keep XML/CSV/JSON parsing local-first. Screenshot OCR remains explicitly separated as a server vision path with disclosure.

academicReview.note: This batch validates transport/schema/provenance boundaries for imported measurements; it adds no disease interpretation, threshold or treatment recommendation.

ff-health-profile-offline.note: Matured the existing offline-safe Health Profile path: core profile entry, load and save remain usable from localStorage when the backend is absent or sync fails, while the UI explicitly distinguishes local-only persistence from server synchronization. No repeated polling or fabricated offline data is introduced.

academicReview.note: Offline persistence behavior only; no biomedical or clinical claim is added.

ff-health-profile-provenance.note: Matured Health Profile provenance visibility: selected source, latest save time, device-sync source and device-sync timestamp remain visible, and imported/server measurements preserve source plus measuredAt when published into the shared vitals store. Unknown provenance is not fabricated.

academicReview.note: Source/timestamp lineage presentation only; no new scientific or clinical claim is created.

ff-health-profile-qa.note: Added deterministic network-free regression guards for Health Profile foundation behavior covering reachable surface, export/import boundaries, offline/fallback persistence, provenance, data-quality diagnostics, bounded history/rendering and recorded-only trend behavior.

academicReview.note: Deterministic software QA only; the test introduces no biomedical content or interpretation.

ff-health-profile-snapshot.note: Matured the existing /health-data Health Profile as the Feature Factory snapshot capability rather than duplicating UI. Deterministic QA requires the dedicated reachable surface, recorded demographics/cardio-recovery/sleep-activity/body-composition sections, visible source identity and save timestamp, explicit loading/offline states, and empty zero-valued metrics/history rather than fabricated observations. No production health calculation, threshold, API, storage schema, dependency or biomedical interpretation was changed.

academicReview.note: This batch verifies existing user-entered/measured-data presentation and software fallback/provenance behavior only. It adds no biomedical threshold, diagnosis, treatment recommendation, causal claim, population norm or patient-specific inference.

ff-health-profile-timeline.note: Matured the existing /health-data dated history and Trends surface as the Feature Factory timeline capability rather than duplicating UI. Deterministic QA requires explicit date-stamped records, same-day replacement, a bounded latest-90-record history, a meaningful <2-record empty state, visible saved-record count, and user-controlled CSV history export with no hidden synthesis or seeded observations. No production health formula, threshold, API, persistence schema, dependency, biomedical interpretation or patient-specific inference was changed.

academicReview.note: This batch verifies software timeline persistence/presentation boundaries for user-entered or measured records only. It adds no biomedical threshold, diagnostic interpretation, treatment recommendation, causal claim, population norm or patient-specific inference.

ff-health-profile-trend.note: Matured the existing Health Profile trend explorer: it requires at least two saved records, maps only the actual bounded history, renders only series with recorded values, and keeps the latest 90 saves. It does not synthesize missing measurements, extrapolate forecasts, or convert trends into diagnosis.

academicReview.note: Recorded-data visualization only; no new biomedical threshold, causal claim, forecast, diagnosis or treatment recommendation is added.

ff-medical-education-accessibility.note: Knowledge Bridge now exposes explicit keyboard/screen-reader semantics: named search input, explanation-depth radio group, topic selection state, live status, causal-stage list semantics, and visible focus rings. No dependency or external API path was added.

academicReview.note: Accessibility semantics only; this candidate adds no medical factual, quantitative, causal, diagnostic or treatment claim.

ff-medical-education-baseline.note: Added a pure descriptive learning baseline for explicit 1–5 user self-ratings: requires at least three valid observations, retains only the latest 12 per non-empty topic, preserves timestamp/unit/user-self-rating provenance, exposes median plus observed Q1/Q3 using a pinned nearest-rank method, and remains explicitly personal-descriptive-self-rating-only. Invalid scores, timestamps and blank topic identities fail closed. The quartile band is not a population or clinical reference interval.

academicReview.note: Statistical terminology was checked against NIST percentile/quartile definitions. Panacea explicitly pins its deterministic nearest-rank convention and does not present the observed self-rating quartiles as a normative, physiological or clinical reference interval.

ff-medical-education-calculator.note: Added a bounded pure calculator for explicit 1–5 learner self-ratings. It returns count, sum, arithmetic mean, percent of the 5-point scale maximum, minimum and maximum; exposes exact formulas; rejects blank topics, non-integer/out-of-range scores and more than 20 inputs as a whole; and explicitly labels outputs personal-descriptive-self-rating-only and not a mastery, competence or clinical score.

academicReview.note: The candidate introduces a software-defined arithmetic summary of user-entered ratings, not a biomedical, diagnostic, treatment, competency or validated psychometric claim. Formula definitions are explicit in code and deterministic tests; no external clinical interpretation is attached.

ff-medical-education-checklist.note: Knowledge Bridge adds a static provenance-aware study verification checklist covering source identity/date, population/context/units, uncertainty, management-claim safeguards, and an explicit non-clinical-clearance boundary. No new API, dependency, polling, storage, or patient-specific inference was added.

academicReview.note: This candidate adds a process checklist for verifying claims; it does not itself introduce a medical threshold, diagnosis, treatment recommendation or patient-specific claim.

ff-medical-education-evidence.note: Matured the existing Knowledge Bridge evidence panel instead of duplicating UI: the evidence shelf is bounded to eight source pointers, sanitizes persisted entries, deduplicates by stable key, preserves source/year/identifier/query/original URL, supports deterministic remove/clear, and explicitly states that a selected source pointer is not a verified claim until the original source is opened. No new API, dependency, polling, large asset, or patient-specific inference was added.

academicReview.note: This candidate changes evidence-pointer handling and provenance UX, not the truth value of any medical claim. It explicitly prevents a selected citation from being presented as verified merely because it was selected.

ff-medical-education-explain.note: Matured the existing Knowledge Bridge explainability surface with a bounded deterministic system trace: it states how a user query resolves to a curated topic, the fixed stage ordering, that curated text is not transformed into scores/probabilities/diagnoses/treatment decisions or patient-specific inference, and explicit uncertainty/source-verification boundaries. Deterministic guards also verify that the production UI retains explanation-depth controls, educational/not-patient-specific labeling, source verification prompts and uncertainty discipline.

academicReview.note: This candidate explains software input resolution, presentation transformations, uncertainty and verification boundaries. It does not introduce a new disease-specific factual, quantitative, causal, diagnostic or treatment claim; existing medical teaching text remains subject to its separate source/academic review obligations.

ff-medical-education-fallback.note: Verified and hardened the existing Knowledge Bridge graceful fallback without duplicating UI: the core curated map remains local-first with no direct network path; blank search fails closed; unmatched queries explicitly disclose that no curated causal map exists and preserve the exact query in a Medical Library evidence handoff; malformed/unavailable note and evidence storage falls back to empty state; evidence remains validated and bounded to eight source pointers; and fallback content retains educational/not-patient-specific plus original-source-verification boundaries.

academicReview.note: This candidate adds deterministic fallback guards and documents existing fail-closed behavior. It introduces no new medical factual, quantitative, causal, diagnostic or treatment claim and does not reclassify existing teaching text as verified.

ff-medical-education-glossary.note: Knowledge Bridge expands each of its seven causal-stage labels with a concise plain-language definition at point of use while bridgeSummary preserves the canonical stage labels used by existing exports/tests. The glossary is a fixed seven-entry map reused by every curated topic, adding no dependency, network call, polling, storage, large asset, or patient-specific inference.

academicReview.note: The candidate only clarifies interface stage categories such as structure, normal function and source verification; it adds no disease-specific threshold, causal estimate, diagnosis or treatment claim.

ff-medical-education-patient-view.note: Matured the existing plain-language Knowledge Bridge presentation as the Medical Education patient-view capability without duplicating or rewriting medical facts: plain, student and clinical depths reuse the same curated topic one-liner and seven stage objects; the shared glossary provides understandable labels; the UI remains explicitly educational and not patient-specific; and Medical Library/original-source verification boundaries remain visible.

academicReview.note: This candidate adds deterministic presentation guards only. It does not create new medical facts, diagnostic thresholds, patient-specific inference or treatment recommendations, and it explicitly prevents the plain-language presentation from being interpreted as a personalized clinical view.

ff-medical-education-report.note: Matured the existing Knowledge Bridge copy-summary path as a bounded structured-report capability: it reuses the canonical curated topic identity, one-line context and fixed seven stage objects in deterministic order, normalizes glossary-enhanced display labels back to canonical stage names, performs no hidden synthesis or network call, and retains explicit educational/not-patient-specific plus original-source-verification boundaries.

academicReview.note: This batch adds deterministic report-contract guards only and introduces no new biomedical, diagnostic, treatment or patient-specific factual claim. Existing curated medical teaching text is exported without reinterpretation and remains subject to its separate source/academic review obligations.

ff-medical-education-search.note: Matured the existing local Knowledge Bridge search instead of adding duplicate UI: topic resolution now normalizes punctuation/whitespace and matches only complete tokens or phrases across curated aliases, preserving useful searches such as blood-pressure and heart attack while rejecting substring fragments that could select an unrelated map. Search remains local-first with no network call, dependency, polling, storage, medical-content rewrite, or patient-specific inference.

academicReview.note: Search matching semantics only; this batch adds no biomedical factual, quantitative, diagnostic, treatment, causal, population-norm, or patient-specific claim.
